approach: Write the height of each ball measured from the moment each is launched, and set the two heights equal at the collision instant.

steps.text: Let t be the time measured from when the first ball is launched. Write its height.
The second ball is launched 2 s later with the same initial velocity. Write its height for t ≥ 2 s.
Set the two heights equal, since the balls collide at the same height, and solve for t.
Substitute t = 5 s into the first ball's height to get the collision height.
